headline: As of 2026-09-29: 395,355 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 21 of 50 states, D+46.1 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 395,355 early/mail ballots cast so far across 21 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+46.1 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (183,217), New Jersey (72,156), Wisconsin (36,552).
